Name: REPRINTBOXLABEL
Description:
Reprint Packed Box Label

Once a box is packed and closed in Packing, we print a box contents labels.  In some cases this is an SSRS report printed to the label printer.
The main way to print is inserting to the LabelPrintQueue with a job that prints the label

Uses SSRS to print box label.  Box label must exist.  Requires Sheduled Job to pick up the record and print it.  This could easily be put directly into the Confirmation as a CLR print and print directly - I just like to queue it.
